primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants experiencing treatment-emergent adverse events, from first dose through Week 12 plus 30 days.
safety_signal: Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 70.6% (firsocostat 5 mg), 71.4% (20 mg), and 61.5% (placebo). Serious AEs affected 2/51, 2/49, and 0/26 participants, respectively; no deaths.
